notes.subject: to Yawe
notes.rationale: Kumasen in bɛ Yawe wele ko kuma直接, kalanbagaw ka Yawe tɔgɔ fɔli ye.

notes.subject: kanuya
notes.rationale: רצון kɔrɔ ka surun 'kanuya/fɔli-ni-ma'; Bamanankan daɲɛ kelen tɛ a bɛɛ ye.

notes.subject: lamurun
notes.rationale: עטר bɛ fɔ 'ka lamyɔrɔ kun tila' walima 'ka murun' — nivɛrsiw fɔ 'compass/surround' (kangari sɔrɔli) walima 'crown' (kuntigiya di).

translation: Sabu i de ye, Yawe, i bɛna némafamabaga la duba di; i ka kanuya ye ⟨kangari⟩ i bɛna a lamurun ni ye.

tokens.gloss: i bɛna a lamurun ni ye
